footnote_text: This reflects a stock unit award, in which each stock unit represents a right to receive one share of issuer common stock, which award will vest, subject to the reporting person's continued service with the issuer, as follows: (i) 1/3 of the total number of units will vest on October 7, 2027, (ii) 1/3 of the total number of units will vest on October 7, 2028 and (iii) 1/3 of the total number of units will vest on October 7, 2029.
